title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 26–30, 2026
summary: Recap of the Business Central Trivia round from October 26 to 30, 2026: 47% of answers were correct, down from 63% and the lowest result so far. Fixed Assets, BC Today & Trivia and Bank & Cash Management were the hardest categories; Projects & Jobs, Warehouse Management and Sales Management were the easiest.
key_points: 47% correct overall, the lowest week so far, down from 63%
Players gave about 124 answers each, and two answered all 250 questions
Hardest categories: Fixed Assets 29%, BC Today & Trivia 32%, Bank & Cash Management 33%
Easiest categories: Projects & Jobs 70%, Warehouse Management and Sales Management 66%
BC Today & Trivia fell from 81% the week before to 32%; Fixed Assets was in the bottom three again

quotes.text: 47% of the answers were correct, down from 63% last week. This is the lowest result so far.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows a significant drop in performance metrics and indicates increased difficulty

quotes.text: Fixed Assets was in the bottom three again.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that certain Business Central topics consistently challenge the community
